item.title: 3 Arrested So Far After New Year’s Eve Shootout
item.description: Police have arrested three people so far in connection to a New Year's Eve shootout that injured a bystander. In an interview with the cops, one of the alleged shooters said he started carrying a firearm for protection after his friend was killed in 2019. He claimed to have fired in self-defense. The post 3 Arrested So Far After New Year’s Eve Shootout appeared first on New Haven Independent.
